context: Two managers discuss an IPO plan
purpose: Teach: 東証/スミス/代目/号線/密着/遠藤/田村/高田

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 東証グロース、上場予定の発表、来週ね。
lines.en: The TSE Growth listing announcement—it's next week.
lines.style: Clipped, matter-of-fact. Slight upward lift on the dash. Setting the agenda. No room for sentiment, just facts moving the day forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。スミスさん、当社四代目社長との会食を組みました。
lines.en: Yes. I've arranged a dinner with Smith and our fourth-generation president.
lines.style: Clean confirmation. Efficient, almost rhythmic—each phrase lands as a checkbox. Professional pride in the detail. Steady eye contact level.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: メディア対応、密着取材、遠藤さんが指揮を取る。
lines.en: Media relations, embedded coverage—Endo will run point on all of it.
lines.style: Authoritative assignment. Light snap on the dash. Delegating with certainty. Measured pace, like pieces clicking into place.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 田村さん、高田さんもサポートに入ります。
lines.en: Tamura and Takada will support him.
lines.style: Spare confirmation. Light, direct. No elaboration needed—they already know what this means. Quick nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 本社移転、首都高3号線アクセスも訴求しよう。
lines.en: The headquarters move—let's emphasize access to the Metropolitan Route 3 corridor.
lines.style: Strategic shift. Slight lean forward on the final phrase. Drawing out the benefit clearly. Collaborative but decided. Inviting agreement without asking for it.
